fields.name: job_name
fields.label: Job name
fields.help: Names the output directory for this run.

fields.name: yaml_spec
fields.label: Boltz input (YAML)
fields.default:
version: 1
sequences:
  - protein:
      id: A
      sequence: QLEDSEVEAVAKGLEEMYANGVTEDNFKNYVKNNFAQQEIS
      msa: empty
fields.help: Complete native Boltz YAML. Define protein, DNA, RNA, and ligand entities under sequences; optional constraints, templates, and affinity properties use the same schema as the Boltz CLI.
fields.help_note: Bio Web writes this text to input.yaml and passes that file to boltz predict.

fields.name: use_msa_server
fields.label: Use the public MSA server
fields.help: Generate missing protein MSAs through Boltz's configured MMseqs2 server. Leave off when every protein supplies an MSA path or uses msa: empty.

fields.name: use_potentials
fields.label: Use inference-time potentials
fields.help: Apply Boltz-2 inference-time potentials to improve physical plausibility.

fields.name: recycling_steps
fields.label: Recycling steps
fields.help: Number of recycling steps. The Boltz CLI default is 3.

fields.name: sampling_steps
fields.label: Structure sampling steps
fields.help: Diffusion steps used for structure prediction. The Boltz CLI default is 200.

fields.name: diffusion_samples
fields.label: Structure samples
fields.help: Independent diffusion samples generated for each input.

fields.name: step_scale
fields.label: Structure step scale
fields.help: Diffusion temperature/step size. Boltz-2 defaults to 1.5 and recommends values between 1 and 2; lower values increase diversity.

fields.name: sampling_steps_affinity
fields.label: Affinity sampling steps
fields.help: Sampling steps for the affinity head. Used only when the YAML requests an affinity property.

fields.name: diffusion_samples_affinity
fields.label: Affinity samples
fields.help: Diffusion samples for the affinity head. The Boltz CLI default is 5.

fields.name: affinity_mw_correction
fields.label: Apply affinity molecular-weight correction
fields.help: Enable Boltz's molecular-weight correction for the affinity value head.

fields.name: seed
fields.label: Random seed
fields.help: Seed used by the Boltz random-number generator.
